findings: Doorway rain streaks are transparent; the formerly opaque striped-sheet appearance is absent in these saved-view frames.
Visible upper courtyard fabric retains grey folds, cutout edges and shading in all six images, with no solid black overwrite visible.
Billboard content visibly changes between all inspected frames; the overlay is running rather than frozen. It remains bright and difficult to read at this distance.
Red indoor illumination, cooler outdoor lighting, bright door-edge bloom and visible scene detail persist across the six images.
No hanging solid-black card is visible in this view. The old left-corridor and every exterior angle were not revisited.
decision: Install the tested fabric/mip corrections into the existing shared Sky Bridge map, with rollback and unrelated-file preservation. Keep the overall goal open.
limitations: Six time-separated stills are not a consecutive-frame recording and cannot independently prove that all one-frame flicker is gone.
The separate 300-frame traces establish zero sampled fabric black overwrites, not complete pixel coverage of the map.
The small protruding feature is too distant here for definitive lighting/animation acceptance; searchlight depth attribution remains a separate finding.
Billboard animation is visible, but close-up legibility and exact authored appearance are not fully verified.
All six images use one saved pose. This is not a complete indoor/courtyard/left-corridor traversal or an audio test.
Native observer equality is checked at the saved snapshot; the capture images and bracketing logs support the held view but are not GPU matrix traces.
Physical Xbox 360 and system-link behavior remain untested.
